issues.evidence: cuts_without_sound_event_s lists 16 of the 26 hook cuts (1.2, 5.47, 15.6, 16.5, 22.97, 25.1, 30.0, 30.93, 31.83, 34.5, 35.0, 36.77, 37.4, 39.2, 40.3, 45.63) = 62%, despite V39's 'click+whoosh on every silent cut'. The fill loop targets a stale cut list (5.07, 24.07, 24.87, 31.07 are not measured cuts; 5.47, 23.8, 25.1 are), skips cuts that already have a soft cue (typing_hard at 15.6 with a fade-in is no transient), and click .24/whoosh2 .28 under VO do not register as onsets.
issues.suggested_action: Drive the fill from measure_v39.json per_shot times, not the hard-coded CUTS list; on each hook cut put a short transient (tick/impact at ~-18 dBFS peak) exactly 0-30 ms before the cut, and re-measure until cuts_on_sound_pct >= 60.
